## 2dae2c34641b

**No issue found.** I checked the five canonical pairs, 600 generated scenes (200 per band), both declared rivals, the task-local suite, and Racket rule smoke. Canonical self-check/mirror failures were 0/5; generated self-check failures were 0/600; all 600 inputs were unique. The horizontal-first rival disagreed on 600/600 scenes. The canonical-fitting “first two pairs only” shortcut disagreed on all 200 generated three-pair scenes, while the distribution included 200 three-pair and 400 two-pair scenes with left/right/mixed bends balanced across bands. Task tests passed 10/10 and Racket smoke passed. Evidence: `checks/audit-probe.json`, `checks/audit-2dae-task-tests-rerun/`, and `checks/audit-2dae-rule-smoke/`.

The main domain limit is deliberate: generated authoritative elbow paths are disjoint, so the review does not establish behavior for intersecting-color paths. That is stated in the generator contract rather than hidden as a shortcut.
